site_version: live v770 / current frontend release v770

status_legend.verified_complete: Proven enough for beta by automated checks and/or live proof.
status_legend.ready_to_test: Code exists and surface checks pass, but real beta proof is still needed.
status_legend.needs_permission: Requires explicit approval because it mutates live/admin data.
status_legend.needs_fix_if_test_fails: Test first, then patch only the failing owner.
status_legend.blocked_external: Requires external device, account, secret, or user action.

deployment_identity.source: GitHub Pages/static deployment from main plus Cloudflare admin perimeter
deployment_identity.note: 2026-08-09 live /VERSION reports v770. Main may contain later SQL-only, CI-only, or repository-cleanup commits without requiring a frontend VERSION bump.

baseline_checks.evidence: Current Node 24 verification passes JavaScript syntax, RPC coverage, local references, version drift, security/runtime regressions, Klaverjas/Toepen checks, Ballroom v769a, scoped live-read v770a, push runtime v770b, and canonical Beurs runtime checks.
Klaverjas static/live contracts are covered through v755r/v755s plus frontend v765-v769 regressions, including live start, scope-safe reads, finished-game handoff and round-scorer polish.
2026-08-09 hardened production health reports live VERSION v770 and 35/35 critical public routes healthy; apex admin redirects to the protected admin host and unauthenticated admin returns 401.

Real targeted push delivery/click was proven in the v763 controlled proof. The production scheduled dispatcher was later migrated to Node 24 and scheduled run #1760 on merge 656886435b9c4dfa5c9cb3b5d9b99af112238b16 completed successfully; current push health passes.

Public game surfaces and guarded backend contracts pass. Controlled v764/v765/v766 proofs established several authenticated write boundaries; remaining irreversible or user-visible mutation scenarios stay separately permission-gated below.

baseline_checks.command: npm run smoke:beta:read && npm run smoke:beta:extended
baseline_checks.evidence: 2026-08-09 base checker passes 43 routes. Extended checker passes 6 stats, 4 ladder, 5 scope routes and 5 protected admin-observability routes; unauthenticated admin pages correctly return HTTP 401 on admin.kalenel.nl.

2026-08-09 performance probe passes 8 routes. Slowest measured HTML response was homepage 113 ms; largest HTML 109 KB. Largest discovered same-origin asset was kale9goed-scene.png at 415 KB. No configured route/HTML budget was exceeded.
Permissioned mutation scenarios remain explicit. Automated finalization work does not silently create game/drink/profile/admin records or send real notifications.

beta_gaps.next_action: No push-delivery action required unless push code, VAPID configuration, service worker handling or dispatcher contracts change.
beta_gaps.latest_probe: 2026-08-09: scheduled dispatcher run #1760 executed on Node 24.18.0 from merge 656886435b9c4dfa5c9cb3b5d9b99af112238b16 and completed successfully with no queued jobs. Earlier targeted proof used subscription 357 / job 24; provider accepted sent=1 and the notification/click was observed.

beta_gaps.next_action: No Toepen action required unless future frontend/backend changes alter the contract.
beta_gaps.latest_probe: Controlled friends/family write proof and later v755o totals/auth guard remain covered by current static regression.

beta_gaps.proof_needed: Complete: public admin entry redirects to admin.kalenel.nl; unauthenticated admin-host access is denied; GitHub OAuth outer allowlist and Supabase username/password/TOTP inner gate protect the admin surface.

beta_gaps.next_action: Read-only admin protection is proven. Request approval before each controlled admin mutation scenario.
